WHY THIS GATE EXISTS: `ags bundle` TRANSPILES WITHOUT TYPE CHECKING, so a
type error is an app that builds and fails at runtime. Same posture as the
bar's tsconfig.bar.json and the other migrated apps' configs.
`ags types -u` writes its OWN `tsconfig.json` into whichever directory it
runs against and OVERWRITES it on every run, so this file deliberately uses
a non-colliding name. Do not rename it to tsconfig.json.
generating this tree's OWN @girs/ + env.d.ts: the GIR modules describe THIS
The `ags`/`ags/*` paths map (identical to tsconfig.icme.json) makes `ags`
resolve for EVERY file in the program, including the external platform's
@girs/ identifier clashes. `lib` needs ES2022+DOM for the gnim JSX runtime.
